fusion_ranked_evidence.title: D4vd's Garage Had Blood Stains All Over It, Forensic Criminalist Says - TMZ
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: # D4vd's Garage Had Possible Blood Stains All Over It, Forensic Criminalist Says. **D4vd**'s garage was possibly covered in blood ... Witness **Lauren Wallace** -- a criminalist with LAPD's forensic science division -- took the stand during Day 2 of the singer's preliminary hearing for the alleged murder of **Celeste Rivas** Wednesday ... and said red stains all over the singer's garage tested positive for possible blood. Wallace was there processing the scene in September of 2025 days after Celeste's body was found, and said the team performed BLUESTAR tests -- used to find potential blood evidence -- inside the Hollywood Hills home D4vd was renting. Wallace explained the floor was covered by black, rubber interlocking mats which had major damage -- including 7 linear cuts consistent with use of a sharp object -- and said the mats lit up to indicate possible blood during the BLUESTAR tests. and she said the inflatable pool found in the garage smelled like laundry, and had a dryer sheet rolled up inside of it.

fusion_ranked_evidence.title: ‘I come from a murderer’: the woman who found out Charles Manson was her grandfather - The Guardian
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: # ‘I come from a murderer’: the woman who found out Charles Manson was her grandfather. He would tuck her into bed as a child, she said, and tell her about how much he wanted to know him. This discovery is the subject of Maddox’s documentary, My Grandfather Charles Manson, which premieres on Hulu. But what begins as almost a philosophical exercise on the origins of evil, with Maddox seeking to understand her grandfather through interviews with members of the Manson Family cult, evolves quickly into a practice of unpacking generational trauma and making peace with a legacy inherited from flawed figures. “But when she was a mother to my father, she didn’t treat him the way he deserved to be and I think it was because of who his dad was … the biggest trauma that I could think of with my dad was how no one validated his experiences in childhood, and so that’s why he felt the need to tell me about them when I was a kid.”.
